system.description: The raksha fans the spark of the Wyld that burns in her soul, and it roars forth in a blaze that cannot be ignored. Anyone who sees the raksha risks his soul being consumed by the entrancing flames of the Wyld itself. When the raksha activates this Charm in conjunction with an Assumption Charm, she gains the following innate power: Innate Power (Cost: 8m): The raksha must spend eight motes to activate this power for one day. The raksha's presence becomes addictive to Creation-born. When the raksha interacts one-on-one with a Creation-born character, her player can reflexively roll the character's (Charisma + Presence) against the target's Dodge MDV once per scene. If the roll is successful, the character becomes addicted to the raksha's presence. The raksha receives a +1 situational bonus on all normal social actions against addicted mortals. In addition, after each full month apart from the raksha, the player of an addicted character must make a successful Willpower roll with a difficulty equal to the raksha's Cup rating, lest his character be compelled to return to her. This addiction represents unnatural mental influence and can be overcome only after the Creation-born has spent three Willpower points. Glamour Resistance: This Charm is a work of glamour. It does not affect characters whose (Integrity + Essence) is greater than the raksha's Presence.
